product_one_liner.value: Vim connects payers, providers, EHRs, and healthcare technology developers through an in-workflow platform that puts data, tools, and applications into clinical workflows at the point of care.
product_one_liner.notes: This summarizes Vim’s stated platform and the healthcare stakeholders it serves.

pricing_page.notes: The page publicly describes pricing models and plans, including enterprise/custom pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in Vim case studies as organizations that partnered with or deployed Vim.

employee_band.notes: The company press kit reports 132 employees.

hq_location.notes: Vim’s press kit lists New York, NY as a headquarters location; the company profile identifies its New York office in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The press kit states Vim was founded in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: Vim Engineering has multiple technical posts, including an engineering-security hackathon write-up and a post on TypeScript practices used at Vim.

public_docs.notes: Vim publishes a developer documentation site with multiple navigation sections and guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company’s current Greenhouse careers board says there are no current openings.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Vim’s public developer documentation, trust center, blog materials, and privacy information; none of the available material identifies the model or model provider used by Vim’s own product.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center names SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA; it also mentions HITRUST, which is outside the requested list.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook identifies a July 1, 2021 Series C deal of $24.7M, while Vim’s history also records Series C funding in 2021. Funding summaries differ on round classification and amounts; this uses the later, specifically dated Series C deal entry.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest specifically dated funding deal found was the July 2021 Series C, well before the 18 months ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Greenhouse board states there are no current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The newsroom’s newest dated items are from March 2026, and the changelog’s newest dated feature release is March 10, 2026, both before the May 9–November 9, 2026 window. The site has an undated AgentFlow teaser, but no dated launch announcement for it was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Yuval Rechter’s profile lists his current Chief Growth Officer role at Vim starting in March 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These CRM, advertising, outbound, meeting, and automation tools appear in Vim’s Revenue Operations job-post stack; general-purpose documentation and data-warehouse tools are omitted.
